examples.en: Mr. Wang is a young teacher.

units.unitName: Unit 2 My Days of the Week

examples.en: I have a lot of homework.
I clean my room on Saturday.
I go to school on weekdays.
The lamp is on the desk.
The book is between two pens.
The cat is behind the chair.
The lamp is above the desk.
The bag is beside the door.
I am in the music club.

examples.zh: 我最喜欢的颜色是红色。

examples.en: I have a gift for you.
I am happy on my birthday.

examples.zh: 我看见一只红色的狐狸。

examples.en: We buy food in the supermarket.
He is excited about the trip.
Get some rest if you are tired.
I take a shower at night.
